exchange.text:
**Takeaway:** AMD's operating margin has expanded meaningfully over the last eight quarters, rising from the low-teens to 14.4% in Q2 2026, after a one-quarter collapse into negative territory in Q2 2025. The current level is the highest in the window shown.

**Trend across all periods.** AMD's operating margin was 10.6% in Q3 2024 (period ending September 2024), ticked up to 11.4% in Q4 2024 (period ending December 2024), then slipped back to 10.8% in Q1 2025 (period ending March 2025). In Q2 2025 (period ending June 2025), AMD's operating margin fell to -1.7%. From there it recovered sharply: 13.7% in Q3 2025 (period ending September 2025), 14.1% in Q4 2025 (period ending December 2025), 14.2% in Q1 2026 (period ending March 2026), and 14.4% in Q2 2026 (period ending June 2026).

**What is strong and what is weak.** The post-trough recovery is the standout: AMD's operating margin has risen for five consecutive quarters after the Q2 2025 dip, and the last four readings (13.7% through 14.4%) are all above any pre-trough level in the window. The Q2 2025 quarter is the clear outlier—AMD's operating margin of -1.7% is the only negative print. Management attributed that quarter's results to approximately $800 million in inventory and related charges tied to U.S. export controls on AMD Instinct MI308 data center GPU products (claim dated August 2025).

**Counterpoint.** The improvement since Q3 2025 has been incremental rather than accelerating: AMD's operating margin moved from 13.7% to 14.4% over four quarters, a gain of less than one percentage point across that stretch. If the easy gains from recovering off the charge have already been captured, further expansion may require revenue mix shifts or cost discipline that the data does not yet confirm.

**What the data cannot tell.** The figures shown do not break operating expenses into R&D, marketing, or G&A, so the driver of margin expansion beyond the charge reversal—whether it is revenue leverage, headcount discipline, or something else—is not visible. No segment-level operating income is shown either, so the contribution of data center versus client or other segments to the margin trajectory is unknown.
